text: From Australia, you fly west to reach Europe.
This plane flew east, 24 hours non-stop, and set the airliner world record.
The short way past India is about 17,000 km, but this jet crossed the Pacific, America, and the Atlantic.
Because records count distance, over 23,000 km, more than halfway around Earth.
The record it broke? A Boeing in 2005.
It went the long way, too. Controllers even offered it shortcuts. The pilots said no.
In record books, the wrong way is the right way.
